تستلزمون (form X)
# تَسْتَلْزِمُونَ (tastalzimūna) /tas.tal.zi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# تُسْتَلْزَمُونَ (tustalzamūna) /tus.tal.za.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
